title: Steps · thumbnail + action
description: Process emails (claim, prescribe, collect). Never more than three steps.
usage: Sequential how-to. Max 3 steps: thumbnail, bold action, one line, inline link. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: Square JPG, cover; rounded 8px via inline border-radius

notes: Mobile Figma shows 64px thumbnails with a 16px gap; ADC has no class for either, so they stay 100px with a 24px gap on mobile (columns do not stack, matching Figma).
Mobile (ADC snapping): section padding 48 → 32 sides / 40 top / 30 bottom; heading 28 → 24 (f24); step gaps 32 → 20 (himobtop, Figma 24).
